title: Silver Rocket Terminal
description: A reference-dependent series: one establishing hero shot of a ray-gun-gothic spaceport terminal, followed by three scene variations preserving the same rocket and terminal architecture.
creative_direction: Image 01 establishes the full terminal hero. Images 02-04 depend on 01 as --ref and reinterpret the same rocket and architecture from boarding gate, interior waiting lounge, and night-launch angles.

generation_plan.ref_strategy: Run 01 first. Use its runtime result URL as --ref for 02-04. Queue may run 02-04 concurrently after 01 is done.
generation_plan.index_policy: Only status=done images with image.png are included in works/index.json.
